description: Converting to a list of lists of any is an error without a common type, also beside a list of null
notes: Not disputed like native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error: the README defines convert's result as the conversion, and the spec makes this conversion an error, because the converted lists, a list of numbers and a list of tuples, have no common type (spec.md#type-unification). The list holding only null can't change that, whatever it converts to: hashicorp/hcl makes it a list whose element type is the dynamic pseudo-type, which the spec has no value for, and then fails when it puts the three lists in one list (conversionTupleToList in go-cty's cty/convert/conversion_collection.go).
reference_error: element types must all match for conversion to list
